base_url.description: The hostname and path to the root of the site (--baseURL)

destination.description: Filesystem path to write files to (--destination)

content_dir.description: Filesystem path to the content directory (--contentDir)

layout_dir.description: Filesystem path to the layout directory (--layoutDir)

themes.description: Themes to use (--theme). List of theme names.

build_future.description: Include content with publishdate in the future (--buildFuture)

log_level.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, or error (--logLevel)

enable_git_info.description: Add Git revision, date, author, and CODEOWNERS info (--enableGitInfo)

clean_destination_dir.description: Remove files from destination not found in static directories (--cleanDestinationDir)

no_chmod.description: Don't sync permission mode of files (--noChmod)

no_times.description: Don't sync modification time of files (--noTimes)

print_path_warnings.description: Print warnings on duplicate target paths (--printPathWarnings)

source.description: Filesystem path to read files relative from (--source)

disable_kinds.description: Disable different kind of pages (home, RSS, section, taxonomy, sitemap, robotsTXT) (--disableKinds)

ignore_vendor_paths.description: Ignores _vendor for module paths matching glob pattern (--ignoreVendorPaths)

poll.description: Poll interval for file system changes (e.g. '700ms') (--poll)
